# Arabidopsis AGO1 arginine dimethylation benchmark

Experimental HCD spectrum from PRIDE PXD043460, F019540.mgf, zero-based index 10976 / scan 18622, paired with F019540.mzid.gz SII_31651_1. Protein: AGO1 (UniProt O04379), peptide residues 60–83 GGRGYGQPPQQQQQYGGPQEYQGR; Dimethyl at peptide Arg3 / protein Arg62 (+28.031300 Da). Charge 3+, observed precursor m/z 898.08997, calculated 898.091886; Mascot score 97.12 exceeds identity threshold 35, expectation 3.9e-08, rank 1, passThreshold=true, isDecoy=false. Original peaks and intensities are preserved.

Source: *The unique dual targeting of AGO1 by two types of PRMT enzymes promotes phasiRNA loading in Arabidopsis thaliana*, DOI 10.1093/nar/gkae045. This is biological arginine methylation in an AGO1 immunoprecipitation study, not chemical dimethyl labeling. The mass annotation does not independently distinguish symmetric from asymmetric dimethylarginine. No new peptide identification, localization probability, or FDR is inferred from this visualization.

The default 0.02 Da fragment tolerance is copied from the source mzIdentML search protocol. The selected peptide and PSM XML fragments are preserved in source_identification.xml (wrapped in an XML root); metadata.tsv records file names, identifiers, source URLs, scores, and SHA256 hashes. The full source files remain downloadable from the PRIDE archive.
